title: Natural scalar comparison of rational geometric fibres
statement: Let Y,l,y,E,L,i be as in [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], K a field, and j:E→K, k:L→K embeddings with k i=j. Let T and U be rational fibre functors over E and L with exactly the rational geometric fibre objects, and with maps on a tensor a tensor f given by a times the scalar extension of the integral fibre map. Then T followed by extension to K is naturally isomorphic to rational scalar extension E→L followed by U and extension to K. Its components are constructed from the canonical integral scalar comparison, associativity of scalar extension, and transport of the prescribed object equalities.

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp. 146-147; finite-level scalar stalk comparison; adic reconstruction as in Stacks Tag 09B8

proof.text: The integral scalar maps are natural and invertible. Form their natural isomorphism, and extend it to K. The equality of the composite ring maps follows from the restriction-to-integers formula for i and k i=j. Uniqueness of left adjoints and the scalar-composition isomorphisms identify both composites.

Identify extension along an algebra map with the usual algebra tensor module, using the identity linear equivalence between restriction of scalars on the field factor and its algebra module. Tensoring that equivalence gives an isomorphism natural in the module. This aligns the comparison with the exact rational fibre definitions.

The DVR witness makes E the fraction field of O_E. Localized-module surjectivity clears a denominator and writes any rational morphism as a single pure tensor a tensor f. This avoids assuming additivity of a functor whose interface specifies only its pure-tensor map formula.

Transport the objectwise comparisons through the given functor object equalities. Rewrite each map by the pure-tensor formulas and cancel adjacent transports. The integral naturality equation proves what remains, since multiplication by a extends to multiplication by j(a)=k(i(a)) on both sides. NatIso.ofComponents supplies the natural comparison.

def lisseRationalFiberComparisonNatIso
    (mT : IsLisseRationalFiberFunctor Y y l E T hT)
    (mU : IsLisseRationalFiberFunctor Y y l L U hU) :
    T ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars j ≅
      lisseRationalScalarExtension l E Y L ι ⋙ U ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars k
